participantPolicy: Use five or more unprimed target-reader codes. Do not commit names, contact details, recordings, or raw private comments.

task.promptBeforeExposure: Please review this portfolio as you naturally would when considering a candidate. I will ask what you understood after 30 seconds.
questionsAfterExposure: What recurring contribution does Jamie make?
What two examples do you remember?
What, if anything, increased or reduced your trust?
